name: laravel-tooling
description: Runs Pint and Larastan after Claude edits PHP, and Pest on demand, then shows the results in a live pane and the status line. /laravel-tooling opens the pane, /laravel-tooling run checks everything, /laravel-tooling tests [filter] runs Pest.

autoTests.title: Run tests after edits
autoTests.description: Also run the Pest suite automatically after Claude edits PHP. Off by default: tests run from the pane or /laravel-tooling tests.

testFilter.title: Default test filter
testFilter.description: A Pest --filter applied when tests run without one. Empty runs the whole suite.
